description: Use this when starting any conversation about the user's own FlareWarden account, or when they ask what is wrong, what needs attention, or what they could set up next. It needs that account: on a connection not yet signed in, the call starts FlareWarden sign-in. Returns who is connected (account, plan, role, permissions), how much monitor room is left, sites by status, open incidents with how they were confirmed, an attention list worst-first, and up to three suggestions. Not for someone with no FlareWarden account who wants a site monitored. Not for another company's service status: use check_service_status.
name: get_account_overview
title: Get the account overview
